Title: 
Full Stack Software Engineer (Golang Focus) 
 
 Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR! 
 KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.
 
 Why Join Us? 
 Innovative Projects: At KBR, you'll be working on cutting-edge projects that support the Department of the Air Force’s most mission-critical operations. Our team is pushing the boundaries of open-source development, DevSecOps with state-of-the-art CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, Terraform, Zarf, and innovative API management and database design. You'll be contributing to systems designed for a modeling and simulation SaaS platform that provides dynamic compute power, access to tools, and collaboration capability through a model that will revolutionize the future of military research and development.
 Collaborative Environment: Our team thrives in a dynamic, mission-driven environment where our employees work shoulder-to-shoulder with software engineers, DevSecOps architects, product leads, mission experts, and defense specialists. We embrace Agile methodologies and secure development practices to ensure rapid iteration, compliance alignment, and seamless integration across modular systems. Our culture prioritizes clarity, precision, and innovation—fostering open communication, iterative refinement, and deep collaboration to deliver software and documentation that’s not only compliant, but strategic and impactful across DoW.
 Impactful Work: Your work here will directly support the Department of the Air Force in advancing defense technology. You’ll be at the forefront of innovations, creatingnew paradigms for providing access to compute power, modeling and simulation tools, and data sharing across organizations to the Department of the Air Force and broader Department of Defense.
 
 Position Summary: 
 KBR is seeking a motivated Full Stack Software Engineer with a strong interest in Go (Golang) development to support the design, development, and sustainment of the GEMSTONE platform. The Full Stack Software Engineer will develop and maintain backend services that support core GEMSTONE capabilities including service discovery, API management, digital artifact publication, workflow orchestration, identity integration, data access, and platform operations. The ideal candidate enjoys building scalable microservices, modern web applications, and cloud-native software solutions while working in an Agile, mission-focused environment.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack software capabilities supporting GEMSTONE platform services.
 Ability to submit a sample Go application you created to solve a unique problem.
 Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services primarily using Go (Golang).
 Build and maintain RESTful, gRPC, GraphQL, and event-driven APIs.
 Contribute to the design and evolution of GEMSTONE's API management platform and service architecture.
 Support development of microservices deployed within Kubernetes environments.
 Integrate applications with identity, authorization, and access control services.
 Contribute to API catalogs, service registries, artifact repositories, and workflow automation capabilities.
 Participate in Agile ceremonies, design reviews, code reviews, and sprint demonstrations.
 Support CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and software release activities.
 Troubleshoot application, integration, and performance issues across the platform stack.
 Collaborate with platform engineers, cybersecurity engineers, product owners, and government stakeholders.
 Develop technical documentation and architecture artifacts.
 
 Work Environment: 
 Location: Onsite or Hybrid-Dayton, OH
 Travel Requirements: None
 Working Hours: Standard
 
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 Ability to learn complex software ecosystems and rapidly become proficient in new platforms and technologies.
 Ability to obtain a DoD Secret security clearance 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical discipline.
 1–5 years of professional software development experience.
 Experience with Go (Golang) in a professional or established open-source setting.
 Strong understanding of Goroutines and idiomatic design patters in Go.
 Experience developing RESTful APIs, backend services, or microservice-based applications.
 Experience with one or more modern programming languages such as Go, Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
 Experience developing web applications, APIs, or service integrations.
 Understanding of API design principles, versioning strategies, and service-oriented architectures.
 Experience with JSON, HTTP, REST, OpenAPI, and related API technologies.
 Experience using Git-based source control systems and collaborative development workflows.
 Familiarity with containerized application development using Docker or similar technologies.
 Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts and modern cloud-native application architectures.
 Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command-line tooling.
 Understanding of software engineering best practices, including source control and code reviews.
 Familiarity with Linux-based development environments.
 
 Desired: 
 Experience developing high-throughput production software in Go (Golang).
 Experience with Go performance tuning, GOMAXPROCS, and overall optimization.
 Experience with: gRPC
 Protocol Buffers
 GraphQL
 WebSockets
 
 Experience building cloud-native microservices.
 Familiarity with Kubernetes and containerized application architectures.
 Experience working with PostgreSQL, Redis, or other database technologies.
 Understanding of event-driven architectures and messaging systems.
 Experience with CI/CD platforms and GitOps workflows.
 Exposure to distributed simulation, modeling & simulation, digital engineering, AI/ML, or analytics platforms.
 Familiarity with identity and access management technologies such as: Keycloak
 OAuth2
 OpenID Connect
 
 Understanding of cybersecurity best practices and secure software development.
 
 Ready to Make a Difference? 
 If you’re excited about making a significant impact in the field of space defense and working on projects that matter, we encourage you to apply and join our team at KBR. Let's shape the future together.
 
 KBR Benefits 
 KBR offers a selection of competitive lifestyle benefits which could include 401K plan with company match, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, AD&D, flexible spending account, disability, paid time off, or flexible work schedule. We support career advancement through professional training and development.
 
 
 
 
 Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture.  These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company.  That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together. 
 
 KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.
